title: Common finite-projective input models over affine stratifications
statement: For arbitrary X and two finite-Tor constructible integral complexes K,L, every affine open U admits a finite qcqs open-closed tree. Each nonempty leaf has a finite jointly point-surjective pro-etale family with qcqs domains. On each domain both ordinary restrictions of K,L have bounded cochain representatives whose terms are specified retracts of finite free completed-coefficient sheaves. No assertion about their tensor is included.

proof.text: Forget the extra Tor-amplitude hypothesis and apply affineResidueLisseTree to the two integral constructible inputs. This gives an actual finite qcqs open-closed tree; on every qcqs weakly etale object of a nonempty leaf the ordinary inputs are complete with bounded finite locally constant residue models.

The single w-contractible affine cover theorem supplies a jointly surjective affine weakly etale object over each nonempty qcqs leaf. Weak-contractibility equivalences give the epimorphism-evaluation condition. Apply affine_common_projective_charts to get one finite disjoint open cover with bounded projective representatives for both inputs.

Compose the open chart immersions with the covering arrow to form the finite pro-etale family. Lift a point first to the affine cover and then to a member of the finite open cover, proving joint point-surjectivity. Strict upper and lower bounds give termwise vanishing outside the interval. The proved ordinary-derived-pullback uniqueness isomorphism, followed by the supplied representative isomorphism and associativity, gives the exact ordinaryDerivedPull model required in the statement.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AA, 09BL and 09C3; Bhatt--Scholze Lemmas 6.5.5--6.5.8; existing normalized restriction proof with unnecessary ambient qcqs hypotheses omitted

theorem finiteTorAffineProjectiveCharts (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K L : IntegralOnSlice.D.{u, u} l E X none)
    (hK : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X K)
    (hL : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X L)
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] :
    ∃ tree : QcqsOpenClosedTree U.toScheme,
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (p : tree.Path S), p.IsLeaf → Nonempty S →
        ∃ (c : ℕ) (A : Fin c → S.ProEt),
          (∀ i, CompactSpace (A i).left) ∧
          (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (A i).left) ∧
          (∀ x : S, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (A i).hom.base) ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin c) (M : IntegralOnSlice.D.{u, u} l E X none),
            M = K ∨ M = L →
            ∃ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E (A i).left) ℤ,
              (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (P.X k)) ∧
              (∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ,
                ∃ ι : P.X k ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
                  (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E (A i).left)),
                ∃ π : (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
                  (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E (A i).left))) ⟶ P.X k,
                ι ≫ π = 𝟙 _) ∧
              Nonempty ((IntegralOnSlice.ordinaryDerivedPull.{u, u} l E
                ((A i).hom ≫ p.toRoot ≫ U.ι)).obj M ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
